meta.name: step-functions
meta.description: AWS Step Functions workflow orchestration with state machines. Use when designing workflows, implementing error handling, configuring parallel execution, integrating with AWS services, or debugging executions.

copy.tagline: 编排 AWS Step Functions 工作流与状态机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AWS 上设计和管理复杂工作流
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate AWS Step Functions workflows and state machines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design and manage complex workflows on AWS

howto.what: Claude 能帮你设计、创建和管理 AWS Step Functions 状态机，包括定义工作流、配置错误重试、并行执行等，并生成 ASL 代码或 CLI 命令。
howto.when: 当你需要编排 AWS 服务工作流、设计状态机、处理错误或调试执行时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个订单处理的状态机，包含验证、支付和发货。
say.note: Claude 会生成 ASL 定义和创建命令。

say.text: 给这个状态机加上错误重试和捕获逻辑。
say.note: Claude 会添加 Retry 和 Catch 配置。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design, create, and manage AWS Step Functions state machines, including defining workflows, configuring error retries, parallel execution, and generating ASL code or CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to orchestrate AWS service workflows, design state machines, handle errors, or debug executions.

say_en.text: Create an order processing state machine with validation, payment, and fulfillment.
say_en.note: Claude generates ASL definition and create command.

say_en.text: Add error retry and catch logic to this state machine.
say_en.note: Claude adds Retry and Catch configurations.
